mainEntity.name: Can I download my birth chart as a free PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Create your chart and choose Free PDF report. Your download includes a chart wheel, placements, a reading, major aspects and selected dated transits. No account, email or payment is required.

mainEntity.name: Do I need my exact birth time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Without a time you still get your Sun, Moon and planets, and aspects supported by both local-day endpoint samples. These samples do not guarantee that a contact held at every moment between them. We hide the Rising sign and houses instead of guessing them, and if the Moon changed sign that day we show both signs and the time it switched.

mainEntity.name: Why do different calculators show different houses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Different house systems divide a chart differently. We show Placidus and whole sign side by side, with a Porphyry comparison too. Check the birth time, time zone and selected house system when comparing results.
Positions come from the Swiss Ephemeris, the engine Astro.com uses. Every release is tested against 22 charts from Astro-Databank and must match Astro.com's Sun, Moon and Ascendant to the arcminute.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my birth data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your birth details are sent to our server to calculate the chart, then kept in the fragment of your page address. We do not store them in a database. Anyone you share the chart link with can read those details.

mainEntity.name: Do I get a free personalized weekly horoscope?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your week ahead appears automatically with your birth chart. It selects up to three themes from actual transits over the next seven UTC calendar days, with sampled dates, the underlying calculations and reflection prompts. Interpretations are for entertainment, not predictions. Missing birth times reduce the available themes. No account or payment is required.
